abstract: Retinoic acid (RA) treatment of F-9 embryonal carcinoma cells resulted in cell flattening and increased production of laminin B1 chain, both indicating differentiation to endoderm-like cells. In addition, RA caused a time- and dose-dependent decrease in growth rate in monolayer culture and a dose-dependent decrease in the ability of the cells to form colonies in soft agarose. Differentiation was accompanied by an increase in the fucosylation of specific high-molecular-weight cellular and cell-surface glycoproteins. The fucosylation of glycoproteins of Mr 175,000 (gp175), 250,000 (gp250), and 400,000 (gp400) increased as early as 24 hr after the addition of 5 x 10(-6) M RA to the culture medium. These changes preceded both growth inhibition and the induction of laminin B1 expression, which were detected 48 to 72 hr after addition of RA. The increased fucosylation of these glycoproteins showed a distinct dose-response relationship. Both gp175 and gp250 showed the greatest increase in fucosylation at 10(-5) M, which was also the dose at which RA induced laminin maximally, while the fucosylation of gp400 was greatest at 10(-8) M RA and declined at higher concentrations. The overall synthesis of large fucosylated glycopeptides decreased in RA-treated cells, in spite of the increases in the fucosylation of specific cellular glycoproteins. RA-induced differentiation of F-9 cells was also accompanied by a time- and dose-dependent increase in fucosyltransferase activity. Although the functions of these glycoproteins are not currently known, the early increase in their fucosylation can be considered as a marker of differentiation in this system.
abstract_ja: F-9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で処理すると、細胞が扁平化し、ラミニンB1鎖の産生が増加した。これらは内胚葉様細胞への分化を示す。さらにレチノイン酸は、単層培養での増殖速度を時間・用量依存的に低下させ、軟寒天中でのコロニー形成能も用量依存的に低下させた。分化に伴い、特定の高分子量の細胞および細胞表面糖タンパク質のフコシル化が増加した。Mr 175,000（gp175）、250,000（gp250）、400,000（gp400）の糖タンパク質のフコシル化は、5×10⁻⁶ Mのレチノイン酸を培地に加えた後24時間という早い時期から増加した。これらの変化は、増殖抑制やラミニンB1発現の誘導（添加後48〜72時間で検出）に先行していた。これら糖タンパク質のフコシル化の増加は明確な用量反応関係を示した。gp175とgp250は10⁻⁵ Mで最も大きな増加を示し、これはレチノイン酸がラミニンを最大に誘導した用量でもあった。一方、gp400のフコシル化は10⁻⁸ Mで最大となり、それより高濃度では低下した。レチノイン酸処理細胞では、特定の細胞糖タンパク質のフコシル化が増加したにもかかわらず、大型フコシル化糖ペプチドの全体的な合成は減少した。F-9細胞のレチノイン酸誘導分化は、フコシルトランスフェラーゼ活性の時間・用量依存的な増加も伴っていた。これら糖タンパク質の機能は現在不明であるが、この系において、フコシル化の早期増加は分化のマーカーとみなせる。
